name: ムシャムシャメモリアル
detailed_description:
Story

“Musha Musha Memorial” is a short visual novel (adventure game) set in the modern day.

It portrays the peculiar relationship between a “VTuber” and a “viewer,” starting from a special livestream celebrating the first anniversary of Musha Iris, a VTuber cherished by the protagonist.

Characters

The Viewer (Player): A long-time fan of Musha Iris. Serious and diligent, they consider supporting their favorite VTuber as a key part of their life.

Musha Iris: A VTuber affiliated with the “FaN x ReL” production agency. She has a slightly difficult personality.

Overview

You progress through the story by clicking the mouse.

At critical moments, you’ll be presented with choices, and your selections will branch the story into multiple endings.

While the narrative is largely comedic, certain choices can lead to romantic or even slightly horror-tinged developments.

Features

Over 15 different endings (only one “happy ending”)

Unlock a special voice message from Musha Iris herself if you reach the happy ending

Each playthrough takes about 20 minutes

Collecting all endings takes around one hour
